evidence.title: Ferrari F1 continuerà a sviluppare la SF-26: cosa significa davvero l’annuncio di Vasseur
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Il team principal della Scuderia ha confermato che la SF-26 continuerà a ricevere aggiornamenti fino alla fine della stagione, una scelta che ha sorpreso gran parte degli addetti ai lavori. [e001:f02] Contents Vasseur cambia la strategia Ferrari sulla SF-26 Perché Ferrari continua a portare aggiornamenti Gli aggiornamenti Ferrari non si fermano a Baku Cosa significa questa scelta in ottica Mondiale Ferrari manda un messaggio a McLaren e Red Bull Nel corso della puntata Race Tech #167, l’ingegnere Riccardo Romanelli ha spiegato perché questo annuncio rappresenta molto più di una semplice conferma sul piano dello sviluppo tecnico della Ferrari. [e001:f03] Vasseur cambia la strategia Ferrari sulla SF-26 Tradizionalmente, nella seconda parte della stagione i team iniziano a spostare uomini e risorse sul progetto dell’anno successivo. [e001:f04] Nel 2026, però, Ferrari ha deciso di seguire una strada diversa. [e001:f05] Secondo quanto spiegato da Vasseur, la SF-26 non è ancora arrivata al limite del proprio potenziale e continuerà a essere sviluppata gara dopo gara fino all’ultimo appuntamento del Mondiale. [e001:f06] Una scelta che, secondo Romanelli, indica chiaramente la volontà di Ferrari di non interrompere la crescita della monoposto. [e001:f07] Da una parte significa che gli ingegneri di Maranello hanno individuato ancora margini di miglioramento sulla SF-26. [e001:f08] Dall’altra dimostra che il team ritiene gli aggiornamenti sufficientemente efficaci da giustificare l’investimento fino al termine della stagione. È un messaggio importante anche nei confronti della concorrenza: Ferrari non considera chiuso lo sviluppo della vettura. [e001:f09] Durante Race Tech #167 viene spiegato che Ferrari continuerà a introdurre evoluzioni anche nelle gare successive, lavorando su più aree della monoposto per migliorare prestazioni ed efficienza. [e001:f10] L’obiettivo è arrivare alle ultime gare con una SF-26 ancora competitiva nella lotta al vertice. [e001:f11] Cosa significa questa scelta in ottica Mondiale Continuare lo sviluppo fino alla fine comporta inevitabilmente una gestione molto attenta delle risorse. [e001:f12] Secondo Romanelli, Ferrari ha deciso di non anticipare completamente il lavoro sul progetto successivo, preferendo sfruttare ogni opportunità per migliorare la SF-26 durante il campionato in corso. È una strategia che punta a massimizzare il rendimento della monoposto senza rinunciare alla possibilità di raccogliere risultati importanti nelle ultime gare. [e001:f13] Ferrari manda un messaggio a McLaren e Red Bull L’annuncio di Vasseur arriva nello stesso weekend in cui McLaren presenta uno dei pacchetti aerodinamici più estesi della stagione a Baku. mclaren F1 contro Ferrari F1 2026 disegno di Salvatore Asero Ferrari risponde con una scelta diversa ma altrettanto significativa: gli sviluppi continueranno fino all’ultima gara del Mondiale. evidence.title: FIA WEC: Qualifying in Fuji cancelled due to poor weather
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The #36 of Alpine Endurance Team will start from pole position for the 6 Hours of Fuji , with the grid set by the fastest time across all practice sessions, following the cancellation of Qualifying. [e003:f02] Qualifying for the 6 Hours of Fuji has been called off because of due to poor weather conditions, with the starting grid for the race being determined by the combined results from all three practice sessions that took place on Friday and earlier Saturday morning. [e003:f03] It's a first ever pole position for the A424 Alpine Hypercar, with Victor Martins' lap of 1.40:694 from FP2 securing it. [e003:f04] The decision followed an early red flag in LMGT3 qualifying after Francois Heriau crashed the #21 AF Corse Ferrari 296 GT3 Evo at Turn 2. [e003:f05] Heriau appeared to lose control after his car aquaplaned while exiting Turn 1, sending the Ferrari into the barrier on the right-hand side of the circuit. [e003:f06] The French driver was able to climb out of the car unharmed. [e003:f07] Race control subsequently confirmed that the session would not restart and that qualifying had been cancelled because of the worsening conditions. [e003:f08] As a result, the grid will be formed using the combined practice times.

evidence.title: FIA Charge Individual in Connection With Creators Alliance Investment Scheme
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Creators Alliance, believed to have been a pyramid-style investment opportunity, operated both locally and regionally from around June of 2024. [e002:f02] In March 2025, the scheme collapsed abruptly, resulting in significant financial losses for thousands of investors in Saint Lucia and across the Caribbean. [e002:f03] Following the joint operations six (6) individuals were charged by officers of the Major Crime Unit of the Royal Saint Lucia Police Force in May 2025, for the offence of operating a virtual asset business without a license, contrary to the provisions of the Virtual Asset Business Act. [e002:f04] Apart from one individual who initially pleaded guilty to the charge in May 2026, the remaining five (5) suspects, including Fernand, remain on bail pending trial for that offence. [e002:f05] Investigations by the FIA into money laundering activity associated with the scheme remained ongoing, culminating in the arrest and charge of Fernand on Tuesday, for money laundering, contrary to sections 28 and 30 of the Money Laundering (Prevention) Act. evidence.title: NTN update: Senate preps China ban; certification and testing; Starlink operators and geopolitics
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The US has banned Huawei et al; 3GPP standardization is in process, plus testing too; Japan and Europe want their own systems; and Starlink is all over the place, in commercial operators and geo-politics. [e001:f02] In sum – what to know: Regulation – The US Senate’s Secure Space Act would extend FCC security restrictions to satellite licenses, market access and earth stations tied to Covered List entities. [e001:f03] Certification – GCF, MSSA and companies including Particle and Skylo are building the standards, testing, and certification to make different flavors of NTN interoperable. [e001:f04] Commercial scale – Starlink is pushing D2D into more markets, notably in Africa, as Japan and Europe develop alternative satellite-connectivity ecosystems. [e001:f05] The US Senate has passed legislation to put a new security gate around satellite connectivity , essentially to stretch the US ban on Chinese tech to space systems. [e001:f06] The list includes Chinese vendors Huawei and ZTE, plus operators including China Mobile, China Telecom and China Unicom – among other (Chinese and non-Chinese) companies and categories of comms equipment and services. [e001:f07] The Global Certification Forum (GCF) and Mobile Satellite Services Association (MSSA) have signed a cooperation deal (MoU) to develop certification requirements and testing frameworks for standards-based NTN services. [e001:f08] Their work covers the two main 3GPP approaches: NTN 5G NR, aimed at broadband data and voice applications, and NTN NB-IoT, for low-power IoT devices. [e001:f09] They want a scalable certification model to support interoperability and roaming with terrestrial networks, as well as between different NTN constellations. [e001:f10] GCF has had NTN NB-IoT conformance testing for GEO systems since 2024; it wants to extend certification to NGSO/LEO systems, and to add NTN 5G NR. [e001:f11] Airtel Africa launched Starlink Mobile in the Democratic Republic of Congo in August – as the first commercial Starlink Mobile deployment in Africa, says Airtel. [e001:f12] The firm signed with Starlink in December (2025), testing the service in Kenya in March. [e001:f13] Meanwhile, Starlink has told maritime customers they can expect gigabit-per-second throughput with their $2,000 (Performance Gen 3) ground terminals by the end of the year, once SpaceX’s new V3 satellites are in service. (This is for conventional broadband connectivity via a physical terminal; not Starlink Mobile.) The company’s network expansion is happening in tandem with its more fraught and complex role in geopolitical comms and security. [e001:f14] Elsewhere, Finnish president Alexander Stubb has asked SpaceX to expand Starlink coverage in areas where Ukraine wants to target Russian ballistic-missile launchers. (And in a speech at the UN General Assembly, Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu displayed a Starlink Mini while discussing internet access in Iran.) Resilience and sovereignty Meanwhile, Japan is putting government money behind an alternative approach, with its comms ministry supporting development of compact universal satellite antennas . [e001:f15] In September it agreed with South Korea to examine future integration, including technical cooperation and use cases. [e001:f16] Which puts Europe on a different track from Starlink’s vertically integrated model: a publicly backed strategic connectivity play built around European institutions, governments and industry partners, with security and resilience as the rationale.

evidence.title: Vietjet signs with Starlink to bring free high-speed Wi-Fi to its entire network
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The agreement was signed in New York on 23 September 2026 between SpaceX, which engineers and operates the Starlink network, and Vietjet together with its group companies Galaxy Holdings and Galaxy Telecom. [e002:f02] Vietnam's General Secretary and President To Lam attended the exchange during his working visit to the United States, joined by senior officials and business leaders from both countries, giving the deal a diplomatic profile that few airline connectivity contracts ever achieve. ## 120 aircraft in the first wave Starlink will first be fitted to 120 Vietjet aircraft, comprising 100 narrowbody Airbus A321 and Boeing 737 jets alongside 20 Airbus A330 widebodies that operate the airline's longer international sectors. [e002:f03] Vietjet plans to equip every new aircraft it takes delivery of with the system, so connectivity will grow in step with the fleet across both its Vietnamese domestic network and its fast-expanding international map. [e002:f04] Starlink's satellites sit in low Earth orbit, much closer to the ground than the geostationary satellites behind most traditional inflight Wi-Fi systems, which gives the service the low latency needed for video calls and streaming in the cabin. [e002:f05] Vietjet will offer the service free of charge on every Vietjet-branded flight, with the airline setting out an ambition to make fast inflight Wi-Fi an everyday part of air travel that every traveller can use. [e002:f06] Vietjet Chairwoman Dr Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao said: "With Starlink, time in the air no longer has to mean time offline. [e002:f07] Vietjet passengers will be able to stay connected throughout their journey, whether working, staying entertained, or keeping in touch with family and friends. [e002:f08] This reflects Vietjet's longstanding commitment to innovation and our ambition to bring leading technologies closer to more people." ! [e002:f09] [Image 1](https:// Vietjet and SpaceX exchanged the agreement to bring high-speed internet to Vietjet flights, in the presence of Vietnam's General Secretary and President To Lam, senior officials and business leaders from Vietnam and the United States. [e002:f10] "We're thrilled to deliver a connectivity experience to Vietjet and its customers, making every journey better, smoother and infinitely more enjoyable." Vietjet describes the agreement as the beginning of a long-term technology relationship with SpaceX, which sits alongside its continued investment in data, artificial intelligence and skilled talent as it builds what it calls a digital aviation ecosystem for the millions of passengers it carries each year. ## A network and fleet on the move The Starlink deal arrives during one of the busiest growth periods in Vietjet's history. [e002:f11] Australian travellers have more to look forward to as well, with Ho Chi Minh City to Western Sydney International launching on 9 January 2027. [e002:f12] Vietjet has ordered 100 Airbus A321neo aircraft, signed a US$3.8 billion Trent 7000 engine agreement with Rolls-Royce for its widebody fleet and selected Pratt & Whitney to power 44 further A320neo family jets, while its partnership with CFM International explores maintenance capability for the latest-generation LEAP engines in Vietnam. [e002:f13] Passengers can choose from Eco, Deluxe, SkyBoss and Business fares, with the SkyJoy loyalty programme rewarding frequent flyers across the network. ## Recognised by AirlineRatings Vietjet's growth has come without any compromise on safety. [e002:f14] The airline has held a seven-star safety rating with AirlineRatings since 2018, and in January it was named among the World's Safest Airlines for 2026, ranking alongside easyJet, Southwest Airlines and Ryanair. [e002:f15] Announcing the result, then AirlineRatings CEO Sharon Petersen said: "Vietjet Air has delivered steady growth while maintaining fleet continuity and a high level of operational reliability." In March Vietjet was named World's Best Ultra Low-Cost Carrier for 2026, a title it has held every year since 2018, and earned a place in the top ten World's Best Low-Cost Airlines for 2026. [e002:f16] With free satellite Wi-Fi now joining a safety record and product offering that have earned recognition from both our editorial panel and our readers, Vietjet is giving travellers across Asia and beyond one more reason to choose the airline for their next journey.

evidence.title: NASA、Crew-14の4人発表 諏訪理宇宙飛行士が初飛行へ、SpaceXに追加3便
evidence.body: [e004:f01] JAXA（宇宙航空研究開発機構）の諏訪理宇宙飛行士を含む3人が初めての宇宙飛行となる。 [e004:f02] JAXAによると、打ち上げは2027年3月以降を予定しており、具体的な日程は今後発表される。 [e004:f03] Crew-14の発表に先立ち、NASAはSpaceXにCrew-15、Crew-16、Crew-17の追加3回の乗員輸送ミッションを発注した。 [e004:f04] 契約変更額は9億4600万ドル（約1495億円、1ドル＝158円換算）で、SpaceXとの商業乗員輸送能力（CCtCap）契約の総額は59億2000万ドル（約9354億円、同）となる。 [e004:f05] ■SpaceXにCrew-17まで追加発注 NASAは9月18日、SpaceXとのCCtCap契約を変更し、Crew-15、Crew-16、Crew-17の3ミッションを追加した。 [e004:f06] 3便と関連サービスを合わせた契約額は9億4600万ドルで、契約期間は2030年までとなる。 [e004:f07] 契約には地上運用、打ち上げ、軌道上での運用、帰還と回収、貨物輸送のほか、DragonがISSにドッキングしている間の緊急帰還手段としての機能も含まれる。 [e004:f08] 今回の追加でSpaceXに発注したCCtCapミッションは計17便となり、契約総額は59億2000万ドルに達した。 [e004:f09] StarlinerでISSへ向かったNASAのブッチ・ウィルモア、スニ・ウィリアムズ両宇宙飛行士はISSに残り、2025年3月18日にSpaceXのCrew-9のDragonで地球へ帰還した。 [e004:f10] NASAは2026年2月、2024年の有人飛行試験を調査した報告書を公表し、次の飛行に先立って技術的課題への対応を続けるとしている。 [e004:f11] NASAとBoeingは2025年11月に契約を変更し、Starlinerの確定発注分を4ミッションとし、さらに2便をオプションとした。 [e004:f12] Crew-14はNASA、JAXA、ロスコスモスという3機関の宇宙飛行士で構成される。 [e004:f13] ISSでは以前から米国側の宇宙船とロシアのSoyuzに相互の宇宙飛行士を搭乗させる「統合乗員」の仕組みが運用されており、どちらか一方の宇宙船で問題が発生した場合にもISSの米国側・ロシア側双方の運用要員を確保できるようにしている。 [e004:f14] NASAはISSの運用終了後に安全かつ制御された形で軌道離脱させるため、SpaceXを米国軌道離脱機の開発企業に選定している。 [e004:f15] NASAとSpaceXは9月25日の飛行準備審査を終え、打ち上げ準備を継続することで合意した。 [e004:f16] 元記事: NASA Names Crew-14 as $946M SpaceX Deal Seals Dragon’s U.S.

[e005:f12] Ahead of Saturday’s launch, SpaceX warned that residents in Santa Barbara, San Luis Obispo and Ventura counties could hear one or more sonic booms, depending on weather and other conditions.

evidence.title: 「貯金と保険が大好きな日本人」はもう過去の話？個人マネー2500兆円突破で起きていた“決定的な変化”【投資信託の最前線】
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 個人マネー2500兆円突破で起きていた“決定的な変化”【投資信託の最前線】 藤原延介: BNPパリバ・アセットマネジメント マーケティング部 部長 ダイヤモンド・ザイ編集部 マネー・投資 ダイヤモンドZAi NISA投信グランプリ2026 2026年9月26日 21:00 記事をクリップ URLをコピー 記事を印刷 Xでシェア Facebookでシェア はてなブックマークでシェア LINEでシェア noteでシェア 日本銀行が発表した2026年4～6月期の「資金循環統計」において、家計金融資産の残高が初めて2500兆円を突破し、過去最高を更新しました。 [e002:f02] なかでも象徴的なのが、株式・投資信託の残高が初めて保険・年金を上回った点です。 [e002:f03] 今回は最新の統計データから、日本人の資産運用がどのように変化しているのか、その最前線を読み解きます。 [e002:f04] 家計金融資産が過去最高の2500兆円突破！ [e002:f05] 「脱・現金・預金」の潮流が顕著に 日本銀行が、2026年9月17日に2026年4～6月期の「資金循環統計」を公表しました。 [e002:f06] これによると、6月末時点の家計金融資産の残高が2519兆円と過去最高を更新し、初めて2500兆円を突破しました。 [e002:f07] 2026年4～6月は中東情勢の緊張が緩和したことなどから株式相場が大きく値を戻し、家計金融資産残高も3月末の2406兆円から前期比4.7％と大幅に増加しています。 [e002:f08] 現金・預金の残高は足元で増えておらず、全体の家計金融資産が大きく増加する中で、直近の比率は44.9％（外貨預金を除くと44.6％）と過去最低の比率まで低下 しています。 [e002:f09] 拡大画像表示 株式・投信の合計が679兆円に激増 個人マネーの主役はリスク資産へ 一方、 残高の増加が目立つのが、投資信託受益証券（以下、投資信託）や株式といったリスク資産 です。 [e002:f10] 投資信託は、2022年末時点では87兆円と100兆円に届いていませんでしたが、2026年6月末で193兆円と200兆円に迫る勢いです。 [e002:f11] また、株式等の過半を占める上場株式も2022年末の124兆円から、2026年6月末には251兆円と大きく増加しています。 [e002:f12] 非上場株式（出資金）なども含めた株式・投資信託の残高は679兆円となり、個人マネー全体の27.0％に達しました 。 [e002:f13] これは、保険・年金の586兆円を一気に上回り、個人マネーの中心的な存在になってきたことを印象付けています。 [e002:f14] 投信比率は7.7％と過去最高を更新！ [e002:f15] 2026年6月末時点における 家計金融資産の中での投資信託の比率は7.7％と、2025年12月末の6.9％を超えて過去最高を更新 しています。 [e002:f16] 過去の投信ブームでも、個人マネーにおける投信比率はなかなか5%を突破できずにいました。

evidence.body: [e006:f01] これを記念して、今年5月に開催された自身3年ぶりのツアー＜幾田りら LIVE TOUR 2026 “Laugh”＞の神奈川・ぴあアリーナMM公演2日目より「DREAMER」のパフォーマンス映像がYouTube公開されている。 [e006:f02] 楽曲「DREAMER」は、2024年に放送されたドラマ『パリピ孔明』の劇中歌として、上白石萌歌演じるEIKOに書き下ろした楽曲のセルフカバー。 [e006:f03] 自身が抱える音楽への想いを等身大で綴った楽曲となっており、さまざまな葛藤や悩みと向き合いながらも夢を追い続ける人々に寄り添う一曲に仕上がった。 [e006:f04] 「DREAMER」がテーマソングに決定した『Ｑ-１ 知の甲子園～世界を変える9分間～』は、今回で5回目の開催。 [e006:f05] 次代を担うU-18世代が、自らの興味・関心を出発点に“問い（Question）”を立て、学校で学ぶ知識の枠を越えてひたむきに研究に取り組み（Quest）、各界の有識者を前に9分間でその成果を発表していく、“知の甲子園”ともいえる番組となっている。 [e006:f06] 今回は、日本全国から史上最多となる349チームが参加している。 [e006:f07] なお、本日公開された＜幾田りら LIVE TOUR 2026 “Laugh”＞のライブ映像は、映像配信サービス「Lemino」にて配信中。 [e006:f08] ■楽曲情報 幾田りら「DREAMER」 2025年3月19日(水)配信リリース https:// 作詞・作曲：幾田りら 編曲：福島章嗣 ■ライブ映像配信情報 ＜幾田りら LIVE TOUR 2026 “Laugh”＞ Lemino特設サイト： https:// ■番組情報 『Ｑ-１ 知の甲子園～世界を変える 9 分間～』 放送日時：9月27日（日）午後1時55 分～放送 ABC テレビ・テレビ朝日系列全国ネット 配信：TVer・ABEMA で見逃し配信予定 出演者 ：MC 林修 進行 伊原六花 リポーター 須貝駿貴（QuizKnock） 発表者 出場校生徒（３チーム）群馬県立高崎高等学校 / 東京都立大泉高等学校 / 京都府立南陽高等学校 決勝審査員 伊沢拓司（QuizKnock） 、スチュアート・ミラー、トラウデン直美、野口聡一、山極壽一 関連リンク ◆幾田りら オフィシャルX ◆幾田りら オフィシャルInstagram ◆幾田りら オフィシャルYouTubeチャンネル ◆幾田りら オフィシャルTikTok Related Tags 関連タグ # 幾田りら # 久石譲 # ニュース # 邦楽 幾田りら、久石譲と手掛ける『レイトン教授と蒸気の新世界』の発売日決定。 [e006:f09] メインテーマタイトルは「The New World」へ 幾田りら、映画『SUKIYAKI 上を向いて歩こう』に出演決定。 [e006:f10] 「こんにちは赤ちゃん」で日本レコード大賞を受賞した歌手・梓みちよ役に抜擢 幾田りら、『VOGUE JAPAN』公式YouTube企画「SOUNDCHECK WITH」に初登場 幾田りら、ドキュメンタリー番組『ありのままの幾田りら』放送決定。 [e006:f11] 初の韓国ワンマン公演に密着 幾田りら、ソロツアー記念で1stワンマンツアー＜SKETCH＞ライブ映像をYouTube配信 幾田りら、『レイトン教授と蒸気の新世界』メインテーマ曲を担当。 [e006:f12] 作曲・久石譲とのコラボに 幾田りら、アニメ『リラックマ』主題歌「stay with me」配信日決定。 [e006:f13] 描き下ろしジャケットも公開 幾田りら、「Voyage」MVをプレミア公開。 [e006:f14] ＜LOVEダン2026＞全128校の現役ダンス部 高校生によるダンス映像作品に。

evidence.title: 幾田りら、美脚チラリのイベントオフショット公開「何でも着こなせてすごい」「めちゃくちゃオシャレ」の声（モデルプレス）
evidence.body: [e007:f01] イベントのオフショットを公開し、話題となっている。 [e007:f02] 【写真】26歳紅白出演歌手「何でも着こなせてすごい」変形スカートからチラリとのぞく美脚 ◆幾田りら、変形スカートから美脚チラリ 投稿では「INKIGAYO LIVE in TOKYO - Behind」というコメントと共に、9月22日及び23日に埼玉県・ベルーナドームにて開催された「INKIGAYO LIVE in TOKYO」でのオフショットが複数枚公開されている。 [e007:f03] 22日にソロアーティストとして出演した幾田は白いトップスにベージュの変形ミニスカート、厚底のロングブーツを合わせたコーディネートで、スカートの裾からは美しい脚がチラリとのぞいている。 [e007:f04] ◆幾田りらの投稿に反響 この投稿に、ファンからは「めちゃくちゃオシャレ」「何でも着こなせてすごい」「可愛いコーデ」「参考になる」「カッコいい」といった反響が寄せられている。 [e007:f05] （modelpress編集部） 【Not Sponsored 記事】 modelpress 【関連記事】 【写真】幾田りら、20年前の幼少期写真が可愛すぎ 【写真】YOASOBI、ラグジュアリーな姿 【写真】YOASOBI、NY街中でビール乾杯 現地公演前のオフショット 【写真】幾田りら、ほっそり美脚披露 【写真】YOASOBI・ikura“二十歳の記念写真”振袖姿披露。
